title: Listener top artist
statementMd:
For each of listeners 1 to 5, show their most played artist and the play count (ties: alphabetically first artist).

Expected columns: `listener_id`, `name`, `plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Count per listener and artist, then rank.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH c AS (SELECT p.listener_id, ar.name, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM plays p JOIN tracks t ON t.id = p.track_id JOIN albums al ON al.id = t.album_id JOIN artists ar ON ar.id = al.artist_id WHERE p.listener_id <= 5 GROUP BY p.listener_id, ar.id), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id ORDER BY plays DESC, name) AS rn FROM c) SELECT listener_id, name, plays FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY listener_id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
